extraction_notes: Forward I-V curve points were digitized from the real typical curve in Fig. 2; the curve is representative of the S1A/B through S1M/B family and is marked TJ = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, 2% duty cycle.
The electrical-characteristics forward-voltage limit of 1.1 V at IF = 1.0 A and TA = 25 degC is recorded separately from the typical curve and is not treated as a typical curve point.

The S1M variant has VRRM, VRWM, and VR of 1000 V; IO is 1.0 A at TT = 100 degC and IFSM is 30 A for the 8.3 ms single-half-sine test, but those ratings are not model-fit points in this extraction schema.
The reverse-leakage value is a maximum at rated DC blocking voltage, not a typical operating-point target.
The capacitance value is a single typical point at 4.0 V reverse bias and 1.0 MHz; no capacitance-versus-reverse-voltage curve is published.
The reverse-recovery value is typical; Note 6 supplies IF, IR, and IRR, but does not state the recovery threshold or a load resistance.
No reverse-breakdown characteristic or breakdown-current test point is published for this rectifier; VRRM is a maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage.
omission_reason: No breakdown voltage/current pair is available, and no reverse I-V curve is published. Capacitance has only one tabulated point, while reverse-recovery test threshold and load resistance are unspecified.
